purpose: Form NDH-2 is used to apply to the Regional Director for prior permission to open more than three branches within a district or any branch outside the district, for prior approval to close a branch, for an extension of time when not complying with certain membership or deposit ratio requirements, or for approval of temporary withdrawal from unencumbered term deposits for unforeseen commitments.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the required application or proposal depending on the specific branch, compliance, or deposit purpose.
Apply to the Regional Director in Form NDH-2 along with the specified fee.
Wait for the Regional Director to consider the application and pass orders.
Obtain the approval or permission from the Regional Director.
Complete any subsequent required actions such as intimation to the Registrar, publication of advertisement, or posting of notices where applicable.
checklist: Check if the Nidhi has earned net profits after tax continuously during the preceding three financial years for opening branches.
Check if up to date financial statements and annual returns are filed with the Registrar before opening branches.
Ensure Board approval is obtained for closing a branch, along with a plan to pay off deposits and recover loans.
Ensure applications for branch closure are made at least sixty days prior to closure.
Check for compliance with minimum member and Net Owned Fund requirements.
